_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 140,855 berths as of December 31, 2021'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'In addition to health and safety concerns, demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2021 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 140,855 berths as of December 31, 2021'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'In addition to health and safety concerns, demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2021 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.00x; -67% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.45; conservative 2yr +242668%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2419.6%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 median

BULL.desc: EPS +2419.6%/yr (FY12-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +2419.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2022-07-22) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.00x (-206.9% downside to Bear $107 / +279527.2% upside to Bull $97506) | Adj composite 3.45 vs market 1.00: gap +2.45 [UNDERVALUED] | -67% above the EPP floor $105 (11x FY22E $9.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: +242668.4% total (+121334.2%/yr) | At 3.7x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $46 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields n/r in Q1 2022, forward net revenue +2421.1% (no FY22 guide in numbers, Q1 2022 revenues); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
